description:
Kwon Si-Jun, a man who was adopted from the illegitimate child of Daeseo Group. And Sa In-Seo, a woman who is the sinner in this family.

"Have you ever thought that I was pitiful?"
"You've always been pitiful. But even if you're pitiful... what can't be done can't be done. You have to be punished." In-Seo, who had been enduring

17 years of long-term abuse using her alexithymia as a shield, finally decides to break free after hearing a single word from Si-Jun , whom she considered her only support. 

"You're the only one who doesn't know that I'm crazy about you. It's always been like this."

However, Si-Jun reveals incomprehensible emotions to In-Seo and makes demands as she tries to escape his grasp. But In-Seo can no longer trust Kwon Si-Jun. No matter what kind of love he confesses.
